Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Aditya - 10 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Ananya - 12 years, daughter
Look: yellow frock, two plaits
3. Anjali - 35 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
4. Anil - 40 years, father
Look: white kurta-pyjama

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Ananya stands in the living room. Aditya, Anjali and Anil stand near her.]

Aditya: "Mom, what's the plan today?"

[Ananya applies kajal to her eyes.]

Aditya (softly): "Careful!"

[Ananya puts a bindi on her forehead.]

Anjali: "Anil, look at this."

[Aditya eats his breakfast at the table.]

Aditya: "Yes, all right."

[Aditya munches on an apple.]

Ananya: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Aditya writes in his notebook.]

Aditya (softly): "I knew it!"

[Aditya studies for his exam.]

Aditya (softly): "Really?"

[Aditya flops down on the sofa.]

Ananya: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
